You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

{
  "headline": "The dal-OUTCOMES trial of dalcetrapib in 15,871 patients with recent acute coronary syndrome was stopped early for futility after an independent DSMB found no clinically meaningful efficacy, consistent with the calculator's prediction of a 2.5% probability of success driven by HDL-C being a non-causal biomarker and an apoB increase predicting harm.",
  "summary": "The phase 3 dal-OUTCOMES trial randomized 15,871 stable coronary heart disease patients with recent acute coronary syndrome to dalcetrapib 600 mg daily or placebo, targeting 1,600 primary endpoint events (coronary heart disease death, nonfatal MI, unstable angina hospitalization, resuscitated cardiac arrest, or atherothrombotic stroke).
